exceptions.reason: Undeployed single-host demo scaffold. TCP 443 egress reaches dynamic AWS/GitHub/registry/package/ACME endpoints with normal TLS validation; static CDN CIDRs are not a reliable allowlist. All other generic internet ports are denied and SMTP requires explicit destination CIDRs. Review destination-aware egress proxy/VPC endpoints and associated cost before a real cloud rollout. This accepts a destination restriction gap, not unrestricted protocols or inbound management access. See docs/CLOUD.md.
